common_affordance: The input directly represents an undirected graph through conflict pairs, so a required answer is exactly a triangle and can be found by adjacency membership or neighborhood intersection.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Enumerates too many neighbor pairs using sorted adjacency sets, leading to worst-case time proportional to the sum of squared degrees and timing out on dense or highly skewed graphs.

recommended_edit: No valid single edit can defeat all survivors without changing the core problem: the requested object is intrinsically a triangle in the explicitly supplied conflict graph. If a task change is permitted, replace direct conflict-pair input with an equivalent opaque or dynamically queried representation so adjacency construction and neighborhood intersection are no longer directly available.
regression_risk: Such a representation change would also affect the already-defeated qwen3-coder, but it would not restore its current TLE-causing enumeration advantage.
